text: We often discuss calendar overload in terms of productivity, but we rarely address it as an accessibility blind spot. When we schedule back-to-back meetings without buffers, we are inadvertently excluding neurodivergent colleagues or those with chronic conditions who need transition time. A five-minute gap isn't just a quick breathing break for some; it is a vital necessity for others to decompress, manage energy, or physically reset. To build truly inclusive environments, we must start respecting the empty space between the blocks.
